name: sol-perp-long
rationale: A9 example: a 2x SOL long on Jupiter Perps that buys a dip. Entry when SOL is 1.5% under its 60-bar high and RSI(14) is under 35; out on a 1.5% take-profit, a 3% stop (well inside the 24.88% limit at 2x) or after 4 hours, since borrow grows every hour. 10 USD of collateral (20 USD of exposure) a time inside a 30 USD budget. Not tuned: it shows the perp backtest, not an edge.
